text: An in-house lab that was charged but never resulted is a hole in the record, and a question the family will ask. At six p.m., Scout gives whoever charged the lab a task to enter the results.
Here it is: Enter results for Ear cytology on Juniper.
The one thing to remember: Save results closes the task. Save, finish later keeps it open.
The doctor on the visit is watching, so they see when the results are in.
The lab's own form is right here on the task.
Interrupted? Click Save, finish later. What you typed is kept.
The task is still open, because the results aren't finished.
The results are on Juniper's chart, and Scout closed the task on its own.

The most common mistakes: leaving a lab on Save, finish later for days, and clicking Mark done without entering anything, which brings the task back. Remember: Save results closes the task; Save, finish later keeps it open.
